paras: In the ruins of Gnomeregan, Ozzie Togglevolt’s leaden phial gathers radioactive fallout for study. He hopes it may help cure his afflicted kin, or make an extraordinarily potent drink.

Ozzie Togglevolt made a leaden phial to gather the radiation left in Gnomeregan. When the city’s vents flooded its tunnels with toxic radiation to purge the trogg menace, the surviving defenders became leper gnomes and the invading beasts were irradiated. The green glow still clings to Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers prowling the ruins. The phial’s lead shields its handler as it draws in the dangerous residue. Once sealed, it becomes a Full Leaden Collection Phial, holding matter for Ozzie’s experiments.

related.n: The Only Cure is More Green Glow
